import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router';
import ui from '@nuxt/ui/vue-plugin';
import App from './App.vue';
import './style.css';

// This sample needs no authenticated API. Discard the launch credential before
// rendering so copying the address never shares it. Preserve unrelated fragments.
const fragment = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.slice(1));
if (fragment.has('token')) {
  fragment.delete('token');
  const remaining = fragment.toString();
  window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, '', `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${remaining ? `#${remaining}` : ''}`);
}
// Memory routing works under a static mount without SPA history fallback.
const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [{ path: '/', component: App }] });
createApp(App).use(router).use(ui).mount('#app');
